title: Love Kayali Vanilla 28? Try These 7 Gourmand Fragrances
summary: Love KAYALI Vanilla 28? Discover 7 gourmand fragrances with similar warm vanilla, brown sugar, and amber notes, from coffee-laced to boozy and beyond.
body_markdown:
You asked, and we’re delivering. A few months ago, we published “[What Type of Vanilla Perfume Are You?](https://www.scentbird.com/blog/best-vanilla-perfumes-2026/) ,” featuring 11 of our favorite gourmand fragrances, from boozy vanillas with a little extra warmth to sweet, dessert-inspired scents that bring to mind your favorite desserts. However, there was one beloved vanilla perfume we didn’t get to yet: KAYALI Vanilla 28.


A cult favorite for a reason, KAYALI Vanilla 28 strikes that sweet spot between sugary and sophisticated. Rich vanilla, warm brown sugar, velvety tonka, and amber woods come together to create a scent that’s cozy, sensual, and endlessly layerable. It’s the kind of fragrance that makes you want to wrap yourself in a cashmere sweater, whether you’re heading out for the evening or settling in for a quiet night at home.


Still, even the most-loved perfumes can leave you curious about what else is out there. Maybe you’re searching for a KAYALI Vanilla 28 dupe that captures its warm, addictive sweetness, or perhaps you’d like to explore a different take on the gourmand vanilla family, from creamy coffee notes to boozy accords and smoky woods. Whatever your preference, there are plenty of fragrances worth discovering, and we list down some of our favorites below.


##
What makes KAYALI Vanilla 28 so popular?


The appeal of KAYALI Vanilla 28 lies in its balance of sweetness and warmth. Rather than smelling like a straightforward vanilla extract, it combines Madagascan vanilla orchid and creamy jasmine with sweet tonka, then settles into a rich base of brown sugar, amber woods, musk, and patchouli. The result is a smooth, enveloping gourmand that feels like a hug.


The fragrance is also versatile. Vanilla 28 can be worn on its own for a warm, comforting scent or layered with other fragrances to add sweetness and depth. If you love vanilla perfumes that feel cozy and indulgent but still have a more sophisticated edge, its appeal is clear.


## Top KAYALI Vanilla 28 dupes and alternatives


Of course, no two fragrances smell exactly alike, and a dupe doesn’t have to be an exact match to make a good alternative. The fragrances below explore different facets of Vanilla | 28, from coffee-infused sweetness and creamy coconut to smoky woods and rich, boozy vanilla.


### [MAISON LOUIS MARIE No.15 Vanille Infinie](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/maison-louis-marie-no.15-vanille-infinie-126560102586114)


Not every vanilla fragrance needs to smell like a dessert. MAISON LOUIS MARIE No.15 Vanille Infinie—previously featured in our article “[It’s Sweater Weather Again: The Best Fall Perfumes to Wear This Season](https://www.scentbird.com/blog/best-fall-perfumes-fragrances/) “—is worth exploring if you’d prefer a more understated approach to the note, with a softer, more intimate feel. It’s a good alternative to consider if you enjoy vanilla as an everyday scent and want something that feels less overtly sugary. Think of it as another way to wear vanilla without leaning too heavily into gourmand sweetness.


### [MANCERA Amore Caffè](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/mancera-paris-amore-caffe-3570)


If you love the sweet, comforting side of KAYALI Vanilla 28 but want something more dessert-like, MANCERA Amore Caffè is worth a look. Black coffee and amaretto liqueur open the fragrance, followed by vanilla ice cream and speculoos, with vanilla pods, brown sugar, and grey amber rounding out the base. Think of it as a gourmand treat with a rich coffee twist.


### [COMMODITY Velvet Expressive](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/commodity-velvet-expressive-840)


If the warm, enveloping quality of Vanilla 28 is what draws you in, COMMODITY Velvet Expressive offers another direction to explore. Its rich, textured character creates a deeper interpretation of sweetness, with a sensual feel that goes beyond a simple sugary vanilla. Consider it if you enjoy fragrances that feel cozy and intimate, with a little more depth.


### [IMAGINARY AUTHORS A Whiff of Waffle Cone](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/imaginary-authors-a-whiff-of-waffle-cone-14309954369116)


Prefer your vanilla with a generous helping of dessert? IMAGINARY AUTHORS A Whiff of Waffle Cone takes inspiration from the smell of freshly made waffle cones and melting ice cream. With its caramelized sweetness and warm, bakery-like character, it’s a fun alternative for anyone who wants a gourmand fragrance that feels almost edible. If you love the sweeter side of Vanilla | 28, this one is worth exploring.


### MANCERA Coco Vanille


For a sunnier take on vanilla, MANCERA Coco Vanille brings a tropical, creamy quality to the gourmand family. Its coconut and vanilla character makes it a good alternative for anyone who enjoys the warmth of Vanilla 28 but wants something that feels more beachy and indulgent. It’s a lovely option if you prefer your sweetness with a hint of summer.


### MONTALE Vanille Absolu


For fragrance lovers who want vanilla to take center stage, MONTALE Vanille Absolu is a natural candidate. Its warm, sweet profile leans into the richness of vanilla, making it an option to consider if you’re looking for a more pronounced vanilla presence rather than the balance of brown sugar, musk, and woods found in Vanilla 28. It’s a straightforward choice for anyone who can’t get enough of this comforting note.


### GUERLAIN Spiritueuse Double Vanille


If you love Vanilla 28’s warm sweetness but want to explore a more complex, grown-up vanilla, GUERLAIN Spiritueuse Double Vanille deserves a place on your list. Its rich, enveloping character makes it particularly appealing to those who enjoy vanilla with a deeper, more nuanced feel. With its luxurious take on the note, it’s an elevated alternative rather than a straightforward dupe, ideal for anyone ready to explore vanilla beyond the familiar gourmand profile.


##
More gourmand fragrances to try: boozy vanillas and beyond


If your favorite part of KAYALI Vanilla 28 is its warm, addictive sweetness, why stop at vanilla alone? Boozy gourmand fragrances offer a richer, more indulgent take on the note, blending vanilla with accords like rum, bourbon, cognac, and amaretto. The result can feel darker and more complex, with a warmth that makes these scents especially appealing for evenings out and cooler weather.


Of course, there’s more to gourmand perfumery than smelling like dessert. Vanilla paired with smoky woods, aromatic spices, or soft musk can create a fragrance that’s just as comforting but with a different personality. Whether you’re drawn to a boozy vanilla or want to explore something spicier and more sophisticated, these fragrance profiles are worth keeping in mind for your next scent discovery.

## Frequently asked questions


### What does KAYALI Vanilla 28 smell like?


KAYALI Vanilla 28 opens with Madagascan vanilla orchid and jasmine, then settles into brown sugar, tonka, amber woods, musk, and patchouli. The result is a warm, enveloping gourmand that reads cozy rather than candy-sweet.


### What is a gourmand perfume?


A gourmand perfume is built around edible, dessert-like notes such as vanilla, caramel, chocolate, or coffee. Vanilla is the most common gourmand note because it blends easily with almost any other accord, from florals to woods.


### Which KAYALI Vanilla 28 alternative is sweeter and more dessert-like?


Mancera Amore Caffè and Imaginary Authors A Whiff of Waffle Cone both lean further into dessert territory than Vanilla 28, with coffee-and-ice-cream and waffle-cone-and-caramel profiles respectively.


### Is there a more understated alternative to KAYALI Vanilla 28?


Maison Louis Marie No.15 Vanille Infinie takes a softer, less overtly sugary approach to vanilla, making it a good pick for everyday wear rather than an evening-only scent.


### How long does a gourmand vanilla perfume typically last?


Longevity varies by concentration and skin chemistry, but most eau de parfum gourmands in this style last 6 to 8 hours, with the warmer, woodier ones like Guerlain Spiritueuse Double Vanille often running longer.
